question: How should `/reasoning stream` be presented in the TUI: transient chat update, footer/status line, or only the existing Show thinking history path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the reporter explicitly asks for OpenAI/Grok-style overwriting and later footer/status placement, so a maintainer UX choice is needed before a narrow implementation avoids cementing the wrong behavior.

options.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
options.body: Render `stream: "thinking"` as a temporary chat entry that updates during the run and clears or collapses when the final answer arrives.

options.title: Footer Status Reasoning
options.body: Put the latest reasoning delta in the footer/activity status line, matching the reporter's later request but competing with existing run-state text.

options.title: History Only
options.body: Do not add live TUI reasoning presentation; fix help/docs so users rely on `/reasoning on` plus Show thinking for visible thoughts.

recommendation.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
recommendation.body: Render `stream: "thinking"` as a temporary chat entry that updates during the run and clears or collapses when the final answer arrives.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the `/reasoning` visibility feature and are the best available routing candidate for the TUI UX contract.
